ValidationRule.description: IM-88: Lock certain fields from being modified after initiative is final approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.IM_Initiative_Validation__c && PRIORVALUE(Approved__c) = TRUE && Approved__c = TRUE && AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED( Team__c ), ISCHANGED( Segment__c ), ISCHANGED( Proposed_Amount__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot modify Team, Segment, Proposed Amount after Initiative is Final Approved.
